overview_description.description:
YouCalc is a free online collection of instant calculators designed to meet all sorts of everyday requirements, such as those relating to money, math, health, dates, cooking, and construction. 
Each of the tools works directly in your browser, gives you immediate answers, and is available in ten languages. 
It offers complete right-to-left support for Arabic and Urdu, and amounts are shown in your local currency.
